raw_blocks: Forward Thinking. Powering Now. ™

At Microvast we create advanced lithium-ion battery solutions with high energy density, fast charging, long cycle life, and built-in safety—boosting efficiency, lowering costs, and accelerating clean energy adoption and electrification.
We’re accelerating the advancement of battery technology, creating a more sustainable future for all, and providing clear, competitive advantages for our customers globally.
The Next Generation of Energy

Microvast is vertically integrated, with end-to-end oversight spanning research and development through the manufacturing of our battery packs and energy storage systems (ESS), including core battery chemistry (cathode, anode, and electrolyte), with established manufacturing operations worldwide.
With 20 years of expertise delivering advanced lithium-ion solutions through global operations in the U.S., China, and Germany—we empower leading customers and accelerate clean energy forward.
Make the Shift to Clean Energy

Microvast is recognized globally as an industry leader in lithium-ion battery innovation and technology. Our team of experts and our comprehensive portfolio of battery solutions continue to set the standard for electrification.

Design to Manufacturing, Quality at Every Stage
Complete control and custom R&D capabilities at each step of development and manufacturing, enabling advanced electrification solutions from concept through production.

We are a vertically integrated battery manufacturer, and as such we design and produce the following battery components: cathode, anode, and electrolyte. Based on our customers’ applications, we can customize the design and development, integrating the ideal chemistry into our cells, module, and packs.

Microvast is ISO 14001 certified for all of its manufacturing sites, and we are strictly implementing those standards, from raw material inspection to manufacturing monitoring and all the way to final product delivery. In addition to being ISO 14001 certified, the plant in Germany is also IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 certified.
Microvast offers multiple cells in each of the three major chemistries (NMC, LFP and LTO). These cells are optimized to maximize the benefits below.
Ultra-fast charging capabilities Ultra-long cycle life Safest lithium-ion battery chemistry
Lowest cost Good cycle life
Highest energy density Fast charging capabilities Long cycle life
We invest in the latest technology and automation to help deliver consistently reliable, high-quality batteries with an excellent safety profile.

Microvast offers a broad range of cell chemistries, including lithium titanate oxide (LTO), lithium iron phosphate (LFP), nickel manganese cobalt version 1 (NMC-1), and nickel manganese cobalt version 2 (NMC-2).
Our battery solutions for transportation and heavy equipment feature high energy density, superior safety, long life, and ultra-fast charging capabilities.

raw_blocks: Our Mission About Us Leadership News Careers

At Microvast, our name captures our founder’s fundamental belief: no matter how large our business grows, we never lose sight of the people that make our technology possible. “Micro” represents the individual – the employees who drive our electrification goals forward, each and every day. “Vast” represents the scale of our ambition and the global impact we strive to achieve as a business. Together, the name “Microvast” embodies this fundamental belief, that no matter our scale as we continue to expand, we must remain grounded in the people who make that growth possible.

As a global business, we carry this philosophy into our relentless commitment to R&D. This strategy enables our innovative agility and breakthroughs in battery technology. Through this approach, Microvast products have raised the bar for what can be achieved in battery performance.
With operations in the United States, China, and Germany, we serve customers around the world. empowering global industry leaders and accelerating the transition to clean energy.
By continuously looking ahead and anticipating market needs, we’re delivering the next generation of battery solutions today.
We’re accelerating the advancement of battery technology globally, creating a more sustainable future for all, and providing clear, competitive advantages for our customers.
Respect and Value for our Employees, Customers, and Shareholders

We build trusted partnerships with our customers while delivering long-term shareholder value through efficiency, leadership, and innovation. Our people are our greatest asset, and we support their safety, growth, and success by fostering a secure, forward-thinking environment that drives both innovation and a strong workplace culture.
Learn more about working at Microvast
